summary_1line: Dasaratha, guided by Sage Vasishtha, begins the grand horse sacrifice, inviting kings and preparing vast arrangements to ensure the ritual proceeds without obstruction.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Vasishtha stands before workers and priests, instructing them as thousands of bricks and structures rise around the vast sacrificial pavilion.
King Dasaratha with his queens enters the decorated sacrificial pavilion under an auspicious star as priests prepare the sacred fire.
Messengers ride out from Ayodhya in different directions carrying invitations to distant kings for the great sacrifice.
